ui.settings.appearance.settings_page.app.tone: Neutral noun phrase in sentence case.
ui.settings.appearance.settings_page.app.length: Section or list heading; one line, sentence case. English is 10 characters.
ui.settings.appearance.settings_page.app.note: Heading of the Appearance section: theme choice, light/dark and transcript options. Same word as the sidebar entry; keep them identical.

ui.settings.appearance.settings_page.cus.tone: Plain, friendly second person; explains rather than commands.
ui.settings.appearance.settings_page.cus.length: Wrapping paragraph in the settings content column (about 60-70 characters per line); no length cap, keep every fact. English is 45 characters.
ui.settings.appearance.settings_page.cus.note: One sentence under the section heading. "Local Operator" is the product name; do not translate it.

ui.settings.appearance.settings_page.sho.tone: Neutral noun phrase in sentence case.
ui.settings.appearance.settings_page.sho.length: Field or row label above/beside a control; one line. English is 20 characters.
ui.settings.appearance.settings_page.sho.note: Label of an on/off switch. "Reasoning" is the model-thinking feature, not an argument or a justification.

ui.settings.appearance.settings_page.add.role: Toggle help paragraph under the switch
ui.settings.appearance.settings_page.add.tone: Helpful explanatory prose in second person.
ui.settings.appearance.settings_page.add.length: Wrapping paragraph in the settings content column (about 60-70 characters per line); no length cap, keep every fact. English is 311 characters.
ui.settings.appearance.settings_page.add.note: Explains what the switch reveals. "Reasoning" and "Thinking" are the capitalised names of two kinds of transcript row and should match the row titles shown in chat. "by turn" and "by response" refer to the two Transcript display tabs and must match those tab labels.

ui.settings.appearance.theme_selector.da.role: Theme group heading above the dark themes
ui.settings.appearance.theme_selector.da.tone: Neutral noun phrase in sentence case.
ui.settings.appearance.theme_selector.da.length: Section or list heading; one line, sentence case. English is 4 characters.
ui.settings.appearance.theme_selector.da.note: Groups the dark-mode colour themes. Refers to the theme colour mode, not to mood.

ui.settings.appearance.theme_selector.li.role: Theme group heading above the light themes
ui.settings.appearance.theme_selector.li.tone: Neutral noun phrase in sentence case.
ui.settings.appearance.theme_selector.li.length: Section or list heading; one line, sentence case. English is 5 characters.
ui.settings.appearance.theme_selector.li.note: Groups the light-mode colour themes. Refers to the theme colour mode, not to weight.

ui.settings.appearance.transcript_displa.role: Row label for the transcript display control
ui.settings.appearance.transcript_displa.tone: Neutral noun phrase in sentence case.
ui.settings.appearance.transcript_displa.length: Field or row label above/beside a control; one line. English is 18 characters.
ui.settings.appearance.transcript_displa.note: Names the segmented control that chooses how finished chat turns are drawn. "Transcript" is the conversation log.

ui.settings.appearance.transcript_displa.role: Help paragraph under the transcript display tabs
ui.settings.appearance.transcript_displa.tone: Helpful explanatory prose in second person.
ui.settings.appearance.transcript_displa.length: Wrapping paragraph in the settings content column (about 60-70 characters per line); no length cap, keep every fact. English is 137 characters.
ui.settings.appearance.transcript_displa.note: Explains both tabs in one paragraph: "By turn" condenses each turn to its final answer, "By response" keeps every settled response visible. The two quoted names must match the two tab labels exactly.

ui.settings.appearance.transcript_displa.tone: Neutral noun phrase in sentence case.
ui.settings.appearance.transcript_displa.length: Segmented-tab label; the tab strip shares one row with its siblings. English is 7 characters; stay within ~1.5x.
ui.settings.appearance.transcript_displa.note: First option: group the transcript by conversational turn (one user message plus the agent work answering it). Pairs with "By response".

ui.settings.appearance.transcript_displa.tone: Neutral noun phrase in sentence case.
ui.settings.appearance.transcript_displa.length: Segmented-tab label; the tab strip shares one row with its siblings. English is 11 characters; stay within ~1.5x.
ui.settings.appearance.transcript_displa.note: Second option: show each agent response separately instead of folding a turn into its answer. Pairs with "By turn".

ui.settings.appearance.agent_avatar_size.role: Row label for the agent picture size control
ui.settings.appearance.agent_avatar_size.tone: Neutral noun phrase in sentence case.
ui.settings.appearance.agent_avatar_size.length: Field or row label above/beside a control; one line. English is 18 characters.
ui.settings.appearance.agent_avatar_size.note: Names the segmented control that chooses how large an agent's profile picture is drawn in the chat window and header. "Agent" is the AI agent; "picture" is its profile image.

ui.settings.appearance.agent_avatar_size.role: Help paragraph under the picture size tabs
ui.settings.appearance.agent_avatar_size.length: Wrapping paragraph in the settings content column; no length cap, keep every fact. English is 100 characters.
ui.settings.appearance.agent_avatar_size.note: Two sentences: what the control sizes (agent pictures in the transcript and the chat header; "transcript" is the name the sibling Transcript display row uses), and that the sidebar rows are unaffected. A live sample of the sizes sits beside this text.

ui.settings.appearance.agent_avatar_size.length: Segmented-tab label; the strip shares one row with two siblings. English is 5 characters; stay within ~1.5x.
ui.settings.appearance.agent_avatar_size.note: Smallest picture size; the default. Pairs with Medium and Large.

ui.settings.appearance.agent_avatar_size.length: Segmented-tab label; the strip shares one row with two siblings. English is 6 characters; stay within ~1.5x.
ui.settings.appearance.agent_avatar_size.note: Middle picture size. Pairs with Small and Large.

ui.settings.appearance.agent_avatar_size.length: Segmented-tab label; the strip shares one row with two siblings. English is 5 characters; stay within ~1.5x.
ui.settings.appearance.agent_avatar_size.note: Largest picture size. Pairs with Small and Medium.

ui.settings.appearance.layers.preview_la.length: English is 33 characters; keep it close.
ui.settings.appearance.layers.preview_la.note: Accessible name of the preview strip (read by screen readers); the strip itself is decorative.

ui.settings.appearance.layers.theme.length: English is 5 characters; keep it close.
ui.settings.appearance.layers.theme.note: Part of the layered appearance controls: theme, then contrast, then accent colour.

ui.settings.appearance.layers.preview.us.role: Sample copy in the appearance preview
ui.settings.appearance.layers.preview.us.length: Must fit a small preview element; English is 38 characters. Keep it about as short.
ui.settings.appearance.layers.preview.us.note: Sample text inside the non-interactive appearance preview strip in Settings → Appearance. It only exists so the user can see colours on representative components; keep it short, plausible and neutral.

ui.settings.appearance.contrast.backgrou.length: Wrapping status line; retain all facts.
ui.settings.appearance.contrast.backgrou.note: Shown only for light themes at positive contrast when the composed canvas equals the authored canvas: the brightness/elevation ceiling prevents a background change, but ink darkens. Do not promise a brighter background.

ui.settings.appearance.contrast.capped_h.length: Wrapping status line; retain all facts.
ui.settings.appearance.contrast.capped_h.note: Whole sentence used when contrast was capped by readability floors. No interpolated capitalized slider label or numeric value. Closest readable setting is what the engine actually reached.

ui.settings.appearance.accent.palette_ov.length: Wrapping status line; retain all facts.
ui.settings.appearance.accent.palette_ov.note: Theme-header reminder that accent comes from another built-in palette. {theme} is that borrowed palette’s display name, never the current background theme. Not a user-created accent.

placeholders.theme: Display name of the built-in theme whose palette supplies the accent, already translated; never the current background theme and never a user-created accent.
